name: ts-notify-shared-record
prompt: Email.send and SMS.send in src/notify.ts do nearly the same thing. Make both call one exported module-level function record(sent: string[], channel: string, to: string, text: string): void, which logs "<channel> to <to>" with log (src/log.ts) and pushes "<to>: <text>" onto sent. What they send and log must not change.

name: ts-notify-optout
prompt: Users can opt out of channels. Add an optional field optOut?: Record<string, boolean> to the User interface in src/notify.ts, keyed by a channel's name (what Notifier.name returns). broadcast does not send on a channel the user opted out of, and that user's summary line lists only the channels it sent on.

name: ts-notify-contacts
prompt: Replace the fields email and phone of the User interface in src/notify.ts with one field contacts: Record<string, string>, keyed by channel name: "email" for the email address and "sms" for the phone number. What is sent and logged must not change otherwise.

name: ts-notify-fit
prompt: truncate in src/notify.ts is used only by SMS. Replace it with a public method fit(text: string): string of SMS that cuts text to the 20 characters a text message holds, and remove truncate. What is sent must not change.

name: ts-notify-batch
prompt: broadcast should take its users and message as one value. Add an exported interface Batch { users: User[]; message: Message } to src/notify.ts and change broadcast to broadcast(c: Config, b: Batch): string[], updating every caller. What it sends and returns must not change.
